sub_site: placenta (maternal and fetal side), SGA vs AGA

evidence.quote: Samples of maternal venous blood, stool and placenta were collected perinatally.
The bacterial 16S rRNA gene libraries were then prepared using the Ion 16S™ Metagenomics Kit

controls.types: extraction blank; PCR NTC; environmental and reagent controls

evidence.quote: DNA extraction protocols included multiple negative controls, such as blank extraction and no-template PCR controls. Environmental and reagent controls were also sequenced
Bioinformatic analyses incorporated contamination-aware tools to distinguish true microbial signal from potential contaminants.

notes: 22 placentas (11 SGA, 11 AGA), sampled maternal and fetal side. Lactobacillus/Staphylococcus/Escherichia-Shigella/Ureaplasma/Gardnerella named only in Discussion as detected in own placental samples; authors call Staphylococcus and Escherichia/Shigella frequent contaminants needing cautious interpretation (not flagged as removed). Stool shotgun genera excluded.
